audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers call Condemn a 'wall-stun' without ever saying that the stun is conditional.
audit.why: Riot's text: Condemn knocks the target back and deals damage; only if they collide with terrain are they impaled, stunned and dealt bonus damage. In open lane it is a pure knockback with no lockdown. That single condition decides where a Nasus is allowed to stand — away from walls the ability is a disengage, against a wall it is a full kill setup.
audit.corrected: Condemn stuns only on terrain collision; fight her in open lane and it is only a knockback.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is named as the matchup-defining cooldown in the full layer but no number is ever given, in either layer.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s. At rank 1 that is an enormous window — a Vayne who uses it and misses the wall has handed Nasus twenty seconds with no peel at all, which is more than enough to spend Wither and an empowered Q. Without the number the advice "bait it" has no payoff attached.
audit.corrected: Condemn 20/18/16/14/12s; a whiff is a twenty-second free window at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers describe Silver Bolts as her third consecutive attack. It is not only attacks.
audit.why: Riot's text: the third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals the true damage. Condemn therefore adds a stack, so the true-damage proc lands a beat earlier than a player counting autos expects. In a matchup where Nasus's whole plan is surviving to spend stacks, mistiming that proc by one hit is how the all-in gets lost.
audit.corrected: Silver Bolts counts abilities as well as attacks — Condemn advances the stack.

audit.whatIsWrong: Final Hour is never named. The full layer's dontsFull[0] says 'Chase her tumbles' with a generic reason.
audit.why: Final Hour grants invisibility during Tumble and reduces its cooldown, on top of bonus attack damage and more passive move speed. Post-6 a chase does not just fail, it loses vision of her mid-chase. Tumble is already 6/5/4/3/2s before the ultimate reduction.
audit.corrected: After Final Hour, every Tumble is a vanish; commit before she has her ultimate.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json — R Final Hour, Q Tumble cooldown

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's winCon says 'build resists' and phases[6] claimed Nasus out-duels her with two items.
audit.why: Silver Bolts deals a percentage of maximum health as true damage. Armour does nothing against it and extra health actively increases it. Telling a Nasus to build resists and expect to win the two-item duel is the exact instruction that loses the game — the content layer already says the opposite ("your giant HP bar is a liability").
audit.corrected: Two-item stage flipped to Vayne, with the reason stated: percent-max-health true damage ignores everything you buy.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json — W Silver Bolts, trueDamage flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The full chart gave Vayne every stage through level 6 and then gave the last two to Skill; the content chart gives Nasus stages 3-6 and hands stage 7 back to Vayne.
audit.why: Nasus wins 52.65% over 1094 games. The shape of this matchup is a mid-game Nasus window between a strong Vayne level 1 and a stronger Vayne at two items, and only the content layer described that shape.
audit.corrected: phases[1] to Skill, phases[2] through [5] to Nasus, phases[6] to Vayne.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged "Spirit Fire's" in `mid` as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: False positive — Spirit Fire is Nasus's E.

edits.before: Wither online — it's your get-off-me button, not a kill tool yet. Hold it for Vayne's engage, never open with it.
edits.after: Fight her in the open lane. Condemn only stuns when it slams you into terrain — off a wall it is just a knockback.

edits.before: E lets you stack safely from range when Vayne zones you. Spirit Fire the wave under tower; every stack denied is her only real win condition.
edits.after: Wither is online and it is a kill button here — Condemn is 20s at rank 1, so a missed knockback hands you twenty free seconds on her.

edits.before: Still Vayne's window — respect Condemn fully. Passive lifesteal plus Fleet means she must commit hard to actually dent you; make those commits cost.
edits.after: Your window now. Silver Bolts counts abilities as well as attacks, so her Condemn adds a stack — the true-damage third hit arrives sooner than you count.

edits.before: Fury of the Sands flips dives: pop R, Wither Vayne, and suddenly the stat-check runs your way. First real fight you're allowed to take.
edits.after: Fury of the Sands plus Wither kills an item-less Vayne outright, but Final Hour turns her Tumble invisible — commit before she has R.

edits.before: 300+ stacks and two items: you out-duel Vayne on cooldown and three-shot her tower. The game is now about how fast you cash the side lane.
edits.after: She takes it back: Silver Bolts' third hit is percent-max-health true damage, so every point of armour and health you buy does nothing.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Wither her so she can’t kite. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: 20/18/16/14/12s — it only stuns if you hit terrain, so fight her in open lane, never on a wall.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Wither her so she can’t kite. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 20s at rank 1, and it only stuns if a wall is behind you — fight in the open.

edits.before: Vayne wastes Condemn — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Night Hunter only speeds her up toward you, never away.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: After Final Hour every Tumble makes her invisible — you will chase nothing.

edits.before: Wither lands and you cut her move speed and attack speed in half, killing her tumble-kite so an all-in becomes catchable.
edits.after: Wither lands and guts her move and attack speed, and with Condemn on a 20s rank-1 cooldown a whiffed knockback is a free kill.

notes: The two layers gave directly opposite late-game advice here — the full layer said Nasus out-duels her at two items, the content layer said her true damage makes his health bar a liability. The content layer is right and I moved the full layer to match. Vayne's 'stun' has one more variable I could not settle from the kit file (whether tenacity shortens the terrain impale); I left the topic alone rather than guess.
